purpose: The sleeve currently averages three lookbacks into one signal and trades one book. Real managed-futures programmes run several independent speeds side by side and hold all of them. This tests whether running fast, medium and slow as separate books and averaging the BOOKS beats averaging the SIGNALS.
plain_statement: Right now we blend three speeds into one decision. This tries running three separate strategies at three speeds and holding all three, which is what professional trend funds actually do.
why_this_is_not_fitting: Speeds are declared on a fixed geometric ladder and every one of them is held. No speed is selected on performance, and the comparison is between two construction rules rather than between parameter values. This is the same argument Step 203 established one level up: holding the set beats choosing within it.

rules_compared.name: signal_average_medium_only
rules_compared.rule: the incumbent: average the three medium lookbacks into one score, trade one book

rules_compared.name: signal_average_all_nine
rules_compared.rule: average all nine lookbacks into one score, trade one book

rules_compared.name: book_average_three_speeds
rules_compared.rule: run fast, medium and slow as three independent books and hold one third of each

declared_before_running.volatility_estimator_rationale: Adopted from candle_volatility_sizing_v1, where all four range estimators beat close-to-close on return and drawdown across both windows. Chosen before this test ran and held fixed throughout it.

hypotheses: Averaging books should beat averaging signals, because a signal average can sit at zero while its components disagree, whereas a book average stays partially invested.
The fast book alone should be the worst of the three on costs and the best in sharp reversals.
The recent three-year window is reported because it is what the operator cares about, and is explicitly NOT used to choose anything.
not_claimed: The recent window is a report, not a selection criterion. Choosing a speed because it did well in the last three years is precisely the error Step 203 measured.
No rule is promoted and no forward clock is started.
